_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in api_key. config.json is gitignored. Paths are relative to the repo root.
_comment_vision_model: Optional override for turns carrying screenshots. Leave empty to use 'model' — the default qwen3.8-max is natively multimodal (text + image) and is declared with `input: [text, image]` in bailian.patch.yml, so screenshots work out of the box. Set this ONLY to route image turns to a DIFFERENT model, which must also be declared with `input: [text, image]` there (DSH refuses images otherwise: MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES).
